next.reason: 1985: 'Sequential organization is a permanent logical file structure in which a record is identified by a predecessor-successor relationship established when the record is placed into the file.' A 1985 ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL (or an omitted clause) is RECORD SEQUENTIAL in 2023 (RECORD is an optional word; §2023:12.4.5.10.3 GR6 'sequential organization with the RECORD SEQUENTIAL phrase is implied'), and §2023:12.4.5.10.3 GR3 repeats the definition word for word: 'Record sequential organization is a permanent logical file structure in which a record is identified by a predecessor-successor relationship established when the record is placed into the file.' The LINE SEQUENTIAL definition needs 2023-only syntax, so it is not part of this requirement for a 1985 program.
